verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI is itself a built-in AI agent. Its docs show users handing it tasks: querying and editing large codebases, automating operational tasks like PR queries and complex rebases, and delegating work by mentioning @gemini-cli in GitHub issues and PRs. Hands-on users praise its codebase navigation, but several report agentic failures (error loops, files rewritten empty, deleted data). These read as reliability problems rather than proof the capability is absent, so they lower quality instead of making this disputed. Missing for 10: consistent reliability on multi-step delegated tasks, an evidenced planning mode, in-depth first-party docs on the delegation workflow.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Mention @gemini-cli in issues and pull requests for help with debugging, explanations, or task delegation
Automate operational tasks like querying pull requests or handling complex rebases
